title: Amazing Trip!
text: Xavier our driver and Jaume our tour guide are amazing people. Fluent English, very friendly and professional. Jaume showed and told us all about the history of Girona as well as Game of Thrones filming locations without missing anything. She is very knowledgable.  Xavier, on the other hand, is the reason we got to watch El Classico the next day. If it wasn’t him who told us about it, we wouldn’t know! Overall, I would definitely recommend them to anybody who plans to have a private tour to Girona.
author: Michelle W
